title: Virtual Executive Assistant - Family Owned Business Group
description:
Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production .

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts . We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.

This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries , gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
  • Serve as a primary communication liaison , screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
  • Assist with special projects , including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
  • Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
  • Highly resourceful and high-agency , with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
  • Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) , Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
  • Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
  • Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
  • Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
  • Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
  • Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio , not a single company role
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
  • Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

Senior Mobile Engineer

Responsibilities and Authorities:

List of responsibilities and authorities:

  • Authority to make technical decisions regarding the design and architecture of mobile applications.
  • Access to development tools, version control systems, and other resources necessary for mobile app development.
  • Responsibility for the timely and high-quality delivery of mobile features and improvements.
  • Authority to mentor junior developers and guide them in best practices for mobile development.
  • Reporting to the R&D Manager for project updates, technical decisions, and career development matters.

Internal and External Contacts/Customers:

  • Regular collaboration with internal teams, including Product Management, Design, and Software Engineering.
  • Occasional engagement with external stakeholders, such as technology partners.

Key Competencies, Relevant Knowledge, Skills and Competencies:

  • Expertise in native iOS and Android development, with deep knowledge of Swift (for iOS) and Kotlin (for Android).
  • Experience in integrating IoT devices with mobile applications.
  • Proficiency in automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines for mobile development.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex mobile app issues.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Adaptability and a continuous improvement mindset, with an eagerness to learn new technologies like Flutter or React Native.

Requirements:

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in mobile app development, with a focus on native iOS and Android platforms.
  • Extensive experience with Kotlin and Swift, with a preference for Android development expertise.
  • Experience with IoT devices and hybrid mobile frameworks (Flutter/React Native) is a plus.

Education:

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, computer engineering or a related field.

Languages:

Proficiency in English and Brazilian Portuguese, both written and verbal.

Computer Skills:

  • Proficiency in development tools, version control systems (e.g., Git), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Expertise in Swift and Kotlin, with familiarity in hybrid frameworks like Flutter or React Native.

Other Experience:

  • Senior Mobile Engineer or equivalent position in a software development environment.
  • Experience in mentoring and guiding junior developers.
  • Minimum 7 years experience.

Personal Qualities:

  • Strong leadership and mentoring abilities.
  • Proactive and self-motivated, with a drive to take initiative and lead mobile projects.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on quality and best practices in mobile development.
  • Flexible and adaptable, with a passion for learning and implementing new technologies.

Expected outcome and deliverables:

Over the next 3-5 years, the Senior Mobile Engineer will significantly enhance the Athos mobile applications by implementing robust features, automated testing, and efficient CI/CD pipelines. The role will contribute to the integration of IoT devices, potentially explore hybrid mobile development, and drive the overall quality and performance of the apps. These efforts will solidify Athos's position as a leader in innovative mobile solutions, with noticeable improvements in app reliability, user satisfaction, and market competitiveness.

Vingcard Athos Team

The Vingcard Athos team, based in Brasília, Brazil, specializes in developing innovative solutions for the Build-to-Rent market, catering to both long and short-term rentals of furnished apartments. As a small and dynamic team, we manage the entire solution, including IoT devices, backend, frontend, and mobile applications.

We operate on a hybrid work model, with three days in the office and two days working from home. While our primary language of communication is Portuguese, all our code and documentation are in English, and meetings involving other teams are conducted in English.

Our team is an integral part of the Vingcard Research & Development organization headquartered in Sweden. We are thrilled to have you join us!

Contract Details

  • You will be a registered employee (CLT) of ASSA ABLOY GLOBAL SOLUTIONS IMPORTACAO EXPORTACAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS ELETRONICOS LTDA.
  • Benefits include Vale Refeição.
  • Benefits include health insurance (plano de saúde) for you, your spouse and your children at no additional cost.

We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 61,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.

As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.

title: Pesquisador Doutor - Algemas Brasil - Produção e Produtividade | Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL/PR
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .

Sobre a Oportunidade:

Na Algemas Brasil Indústria, Comércio e Monitoramento de Sistemas, inovação também significa evoluir produtos e tornar a operação cada vez mais eficiente. Por isso, buscamos um profissional com olhar técnico e estratégico para contribuir com melhorias nos produtos já existentes, apoiar o desenvolvimento de novos produtos e atuar na adequação dos processos produtivos necessários para viabilizar essas mudanças.

O projeto envolve analisar tecnicamente oportunidades de evolução do portfólio, propor ajustes com foco em aplicabilidade industrial e apoiar melhorias no chão de fábrica para acomodar alterações de produto e processo. A atuação terá impacto direto na eficiência da operação, na organização produtiva e na capacidade da empresa de evoluir suas soluções de forma estruturada e sustentável.

Se você quer aplicar seu conhecimento em um contexto industrial desafiador, conectando engenharia, melhoria contínua e desenvolvimento de soluções com impacto prático no negócio, esta oportunidade é para você.

Formação Acadêmica:

Engenharia de Produto e afins

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Projeto: Produção e Produtividade

Principais Atividades:

  • Atuar na análise, revisão e aprimoramento dos produtos já existentes da empresa, propondo melhorias técnicas e funcionais.
  • Contribuir no desenvolvimento de possíveis novos produtos, considerando viabilidade técnica, aplicação prática e alinhamento com a estratégia do negócio.
  • Avaliar impactos das alterações de produto no processo produtivo, apoiando a adaptação do chão de fábrica para absorver essas mudanças.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de fabricação, com foco em eficiência, produtividade e padronização.

Conhecimento necessário:

  • Conhecimento com desenvolvimento, revisão e melhoria de produtos;
  • Conhecimento em processos de fabricação, ambiente industrial ou chão de fábrica;
  • Conhecimento em análise de viabilidade técnica de alterações de produto e processo;
  • Capacidade de identificar oportunidades de melhoria em produtos e fluxos produtivos;

Conhecimento desejável:

  • Conhecimento em desenho técnico, especificações de produto ou documentação de engenharia.
  • Familiaridade com melhoria contínua, Lean Manufacturing ou otimização de processos.

Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial

Formato de trabalho : Presencial

Local: Almirante Tamandaré/PR

Soft Skills : Autonomia, Pensamento Crítico, Organização.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:

  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Assessor de investimentos Sênior
description:
Somos a WV INVESTIMENTOS , um escritório de assessoria credenciado à XP , que nasceu com o objetivo de auxiliar as pessoas a realizarem seus sonhos e construírem seus legados . Atualmente com matriz em Florianópolis - Santa Catarina e filiais em São Paulo, Minas Gerais e Paraná. 

Sobre a vaga:

Buscamos profissionais com base ativa de clientes , forte perfil comercial e excelente rede de relacionamentos para atuar como Planejador Financeiro ( Assessor de Investimentos ), com foco no atendimento a clientes alta renda e private .

  • Desenvolver e acompanhar planos financeiros personalizados, voltados para auxiliar os clientes a alcançar seus objetivos de curto, médio e longo prazo, por meio de estratégias de investimento alinhadas ao seu perfil e necessidades;
  • Realizar contato constante e proativo com os clientes, analisando o desempenho das carteiras e realizando ajustes estratégicos quando necessário;
  • Construir e manter relacionamentos de confiança com os clientes, oferecendo suporte e orientação em todas as decisões financeiras;
  • Identificar o perfil de risco e as necessidades específicas de cada cliente;
  • Apresentar soluções de investimento adequadas ao perfil e aos objetivos individuais;
  • Realizar prospecção ativa de novos clientes de alta renda fora e dentro de sua rede de contatos;
  • Participar e realizar eventos de relacionamento com atuais e futuros clientes.

  • Base ativa de clientes (com histórico mínimo de 1 ano de relacionamento );
  • Registro ativo na CVM (Certificação ANCORD ) ou agendamento de prova com aprovação em até 3 meses
  • Disponibilidade para atuar presencialmente  em alguma das regiões mencionadas;
  • Boa rede de relacionamento comercial
  • Afinidade com a área comercial e interesse genuíno em atender e prospectar clientes;
  • Capacidade de manter bons relacionamentos
  • Experiência com clientes de alta renda.

Seria interessante se você tiver, mas não é obrigatório:

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de análise de investimentos e CRM.
  • Certificações do mercado financeiro: CFP, CEA;

O que oferecemos:

title: Analista de dados sênior
description:
Venha construir o futuro com a B3!

Estamos com diversas oportunidades abertas para atuar como Analista de Dados Sênior na B3, uma das principais infraestruturas de mercado financeiro do mundo. Aqui, trabalhamos diariamente para garantir alta disponibilidade, performance, segurança e inovação, sustentando operações críticas que movimentam grande parte da economia brasileira.

Como será o seu dia a dia

• Desenvolver e manter automações para coleta, processamento e apresentação de dados e indicadores;

• Garantir a qualidade, precisão e atualização dos dados apresentados à diretoria;

• Apoiar a equipe na identificação de melhorias nos processos internos por meio de automação e análise;

• Produzir relatórios gerenciais e dashboards para suporte à tomada de decisão.

Responsabilidades da área

As atividades podem abranger diferentes unidades da B3, envolvendo:

• Plataformas de negociação, pós-negociação, risco e clearing;

• Processamento e cálculo de produtos financeiros listados e de balcão;

• Sistemas de preços, curvas, volatilidades e túneis de negociação;

• Ambientes de alta disponibilidade, baixa latência e grande volume transacional;

• Arquiteturas distribuídas e soluções estratégicas em constante modernização.

O que esperamos da sua atuação

• Formação superior completa;

• Experiência comprovada em Power Automate;

• Conhecimento desejável em Databricks;

• Perfil analítico e capacidade de interpretar grandes volumes de dados.

• Experiência sólida em análise de dados (nível sênior).

•Domínio de SQL para manipulação de grandes bases.

• Experiência com ferramentas de visualização (Power BI, Tableau ou similares).

title: Engenheiro Especialista em Manutenção de Turbinas Hidráulicas
description:

title: Regulatory Affairs Analyst
description:
Job Title: Regulatory Affairs (RA) Analyst

About the Position

The Regulatory Affairs Analyst will be responsible for managing regulatory submissions and ensuring compliance with local and international regulatory requirements. This role plays a key part in supporting new product registrations, post-marketing activities, and regulatory strategy execution within the pharmaceutical domain.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

  • Prepare, review, and submit high-quality CTD dossiers for new drug product registrations and post-marketing variations in compliance with regulatory requirements.
  • Prepare and respond to Deficiency Letters issued by ANVISA , ensuring timely and accurate submissions.
  • Conduct risk assessments and gap analyses to enhance regulatory processes and improve dossier quality.
  • Develop and implement regulatory strategies for Pharmaceutical Equivalence Studies and Biowaivers , including coordination of outsourcing activities.
  • Support and monitor the importation process in line with regulatory compliance requirements.
  • Evaluate regulatory feasibility and identify potential risks or requirements to support project execution.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Regulatory Affairs or Technical Documentation within the pharmaceutical industry .
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Pharmacy, Chemistry, Biology, Biomedicine, or a related field.
  • Strong working knowledge of ANVISA regulations , as well as international regulatory guidelines and processes.
  • Proven ability to manage regulatory documentation with accuracy, attention to detail, and compliance focus.

description:
RESUMO DO CARGO

Sobre a Ardagh:

A Ardagh Metal Packaging (AMP) é uma das líderes globais na produção e venda de embalagens de alumínio para bebidas, com 3 unidades de produção no Brasil - fábricas de latas em Jacareí (SP) e Alagoinhas (BA) e uma fábrica de tampas de Manaus (AM) – e um escritório localizado em São Paulo. Globalmente, a AMP opera 24 instalações de produção nas Américas e Europa, empregando cerca de 5.800 funcionários e registrou receitas de US $ 4 bilhões em 2021. title: Sales Enablement Specialist, Digital Course & Access Programs
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.

The Role

JoVE is seeking a Sales Enablement Specialist - Digital Course Materials & Access Programs to support the operational delivery and adoption of JoVE’s digital science video platform across higher education institutions.

This role sits within the Sales Enablement team and focuses on managing course material adoptions, supporting bookstore affordability programs such as Inclusive Access and Equitable Access, and ensuring the reliable delivery of JoVE content through Learning Management Systems (LMS).

While JoVE’s Customer Success team works directly with faculty on course-level implementation, this role focuses on operational workflows, adoption tracking, data analysis, and identifying trends or systemic issues affecting digital course material delivery.

The ideal candidate combines strong operational and analytical skills with meaningful experience working with LMS platforms and LTI-based integrations used in higher education courseware delivery.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage course material adoptions and digital product fulfillment across higher education accounts.
  • Support the implementation and administration of Inclusive Access and Equitable Access programs with university bookstores.
  • Coordinate course setup and delivery of digital materials through bookstore distribution systems.
  • Analyze sales, adoption, and fulfillment data to create reports and dashboards that support forecasting, planning, and decision-making.
  • Provide insights to Sales leadership on adoption performance and program growth.
  • Identify trends, gaps, and opportunities in bookstore and digital distribution workflows.
  • Monitor workflows that support JoVE content delivery through Learning Management Systems (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, D2L, etc.). Recommend process improvements and system enhancements to support scalable program delivery.
  • Apply working knowledge of LTI integrations and LMS courseware delivery models to diagnose access or authentication issues.

Requirements

  • A Bachelor’s degree
  • 3+ years experience in EdTech, digital publishing, sales operations, or academic technology environments
  • Strong familiarity with Learning Management Systems (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, Brightspace, etc.)
  • Demonstrated experience working with LTI integrations or LMS-based courseware delivery
  • Strong experience using Salesforce or similar CRM platforms
  • Results-driven, strong organization and analytical skills
  • Ability to work independently in a fast paced environment

Why JoVE?

  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Client Success Manager
description:
Client Success Manager

We are looking for a full-time, remote Client Success Manager with 4+ years of experience working in a software, technical recruiting, or technical outsourcing client services role. This role combines client advocacy with revenue responsibilities, focusing on retention and growth within existing client accounts.

This individual will build loyalty and long-term engagement with our clients driving strategy and execution within client retention programs, account reviews, health checks, cross-sales, issue resolution, interview management, KPI tracking and administration, and more.

Reporting to the Head of Client Success, you will advocate for the client across all of Velozient and will play an integral role in our service delivery team.

Responsibilities

  • Develop strong client relationships built on high responsiveness and advocacy
  • Serve as the primary owner of account growth plans, including retention, expansion, and long-term account value
  • Identify and close new sales opportunities within existing accounts, build job descriptions when necessary, and kick off new job recruiting efforts
  • Plan and execute successful client retention programs that drive loyalty and satisfaction measured by NPS and CSAT respectively
  • Review and submit candidates for open client jobs
  • Coordinate candidate interviews and gather feedback communicating next steps within the People Success (a.k.a., recruiting) and Account Management teams
  • Collaborate with account managers on key account activity
  • Conduct client onboarding sessions
  • Perform periodic health checks and ensure new resources are onboarded successfully with the client
  • Collaborate with People Success in investigating and resolving resource issues
  • Provide needed service information to clients including resource holiday calendars and answer general client inquiries
  • Coordinate and contribute to annual account review preparation and execution
  • Exhibit high integrity, a self-starter approach, and commitment to owning work outcomes

Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills with the ability to lead executive-level conversations
  • 4+ years of experience in Client Success, Account Management, Client Services, or a related customer-facing role within recruiting, staffing, SaaS, or professional services environments focused on software/technology
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) process and related technical roles
  • Proven ability to build and maintain long-term, trusted client relationships across multiple stakeholder levels, including senior leadership
  • Proven experience growing revenue within existing client accounts through cross selling or account expansion
  • Strong background conducting client onboarding, health checks, and business reviews to ensure successful outcomes and long-term engagement
  • Experience collaborating closely with Sales, Recruiting/Delivery, Operations, and Finance teams to drive client success and account growth
  • Data-driven approach to managing accounts, including tracking KPIs, NPS, CSAT, retention, hiring velocity, and revenue growth
  • Comfort managing complex client environments, navigating change, resolving issues, and balancing client advocacy with business objectives
  • Strong, innate desire to advocate for the client
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, attention to detail, and multi-tasking background
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (i.e., Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint)
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, accountable, and trustworthy

Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, computer science, or a related field
  • Experience selling IT, software development, or outsourcing services
  • Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - lets learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software engineering company providing outsourced software resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer engineering talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building and delivering software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

description:

We are a leading provider of energy efficient, innovative equipment, instrumentation, and process control systems to the global mining industry. This role is for a position within the Advanced Process Control (APC) department. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys travelling and has an analytical mind.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;

  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: National Sales Director (Brazil)
description:
Job Title: National Sales Director - Brazil

Reports To: Head of Overseas Business Unit

Location: Brazil (Remote, frequent travel required)

Position Overview

To support the company's strategic development, we are investing significantly in the Brazilian market to accelerate brand growth, product localization, and sales network expansion. We are seeking a National Sales Director for Brazil who will be responsible for the overall market strategy, sales planning, channel development, and team leadership. The goal is to rapidly achieve broad product coverage across Brazil and develop tailored product and sales strategies for the local market.

The ideal candidate will have established nationwide distributor and customer relationships, enabling them to contribute immediately. Preference will be given to candidates with prior experience at leading baking ingredient manufacturers in a similar role.

Key Responsibilities

A. Market Strategy & Planning

  1. Develop and execute the overall sales strategy, channel plan, and annual business objectives for Brazil.
  2. Lead product localization initiatives to meet Brazilian market needs and drive product adaptation.
  3. Rapidly expand the national sales network to ensure broad market coverage.

B. Channel Development & Management

  1. Identify, negotiate with, and onboard national distributors and key strategic partners.
  2. Manage relationships with distributors and major customers, optimizing processes and service delivery.
  3. Maintain distributor and customer profiles, conduct regular performance reviews, and implement improvement plans.

C. Brand & Marketing Promotion

  1. Develop and implement brand-building activities, including marketing campaigns, PR events, and digital outreach.
  2. Organize product demonstrations, technical trainings, and industry exhibitions to increase brand visibility.

D. Cross-functional Collaboration

  1. Work closely with product, R&D, and marketing teams to share market insights and support product development.
  2. Provide training and support to distributors and customers on products, applications, and sales techniques.

E. Market & Competitive Intelligence

  1. Monitor competitor activities, market trends, and regulatory changes to adjust strategies proactively.
  2. Prepare regular market reports and business forecasts for headquarters.

Qualifications

A. Experience

  1. Minimum 15 years of sales management experience in the baking ingredients industry, with a focus on non-dairy whipping toppings or related products, specifically in the Brazilian market.
  2. Previous experience in a similar role at companies is highly preferred.
  3. Established network of national distributors and key clients, with the ability to execute quickly.

B. Knowledge

  1. Full understanding of bakery products and familiarity with bakery operations or production processes.
  2. Proficient in Microsoft Office for data analysis, reporting, and presentation.

C. Competency

  1. Strong strategic thinking, negotiation skills, and business acumen.
  2. Resilient under pressure and willing to travel frequently.
  3. Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills.

We Offer

  1. Competitive compensation package.
  2. Opportunity to lead in a high-priority strategic market with significant growth potential.
  3. Full support from global headquarters in product, marketing, and technical resources.

About Hi-Road Food Technology

Shanghai Hi-road Food Technology Co., Ltd. is a leading integrated enterprise specializing in the research, development, production, and distribution of premium bakery and catering ingredients. Committed to becoming the preferred partner in the global baking industry, we dedicate ourselves to providing customers with innovative, safe, and delicious food solutions.

With our strong independent R&D capabilities, Hi-Road meticulously sources world-class raw materials and employs advanced production technologies. Our comprehensive quality control system ensures the consistent excellence of our diverse product portfolio, which includes:

•Dairy and non-dairy toppings

•Premium fruit preparations

•Chocolate products

•Bakery creams and margarine compounds

•Flavor sauces

•Food flavors and additives

Through continuous innovation and stringent quality standards, we strive to deliver exceptional value and culinary inspiration to our partners worldwide

title: DevOps Engineer SR
description:
DevOps Engineer SR

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

This is a highly sensitive and mission‑critical role with admin‑level access to the core platform. The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‑minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‑scale production systems.

You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure including ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Design, deploy, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using AWS CloudFormation;
  • Own and enhance CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI or similar tools, including automated deployments, rollback strategies, and environment versioning;
  • Implement and maintain observability frameworks leveraging tools such as New Relic and Splunk for monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response;
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across databases, services, network layers, and workloads;
  • Lead AWS cost‑optimization initiatives, ensuring performance and reliability remain uncompromised;
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
  • Ensure best‑in‑class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.

Essential Skills

  • Expertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Strong experience with CloudFormation for managing AWS infrastructure;
  • Hands-on experience with CircleCI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
  • Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
  • Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora MySQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;
  • Strong understanding of Aurora architecture, read replicas, automated backups, point-in-time recovery, failover mechanisms, and high availability patterns;
  • Proven track record performing database version upgrades in production with minimal downtime, including compatibility testing, replication management, and performance validation.

About Encora

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Gerente Comercial de Human Nutrition
description:

A Barentz é uma distribuidora líder global de ingredientes de alto desempenho para ciências biológicas. A empresa oferece ingredientes e especialidades dos principais fabricantes em todo o mundo, bem como suporte técnico de valor agregado, incluindo pré-mistura, mistura, formulação de ingredientes e testes de ingredientes em seus centros de formulação e laboratórios de aplicações de última geração na região EMEA, Américas e Ásia-Pacífico.

Fundada em 1953, a Barentz opera em mais de 70 países, com forte presença na Europa e na América do Norte e uma rede em rápido crescimento na América Latina e na Ásia-Pacífico. Com um volume de negócios de 2,5 mil milhões de euros, a empresa emprega mais de 2.500 pessoas em todo o mundo e serve mais de 25.000 clientes. Para mais informações visite nosso site: .

title: Analista Financeiro Sênior
description:

Missão do Cargo

Responsável pela análise contábil dos documentos processados pela empresa (notas fiscais, faturas, pagamentos, recebimentos, tributos, entre outros), garantindo o correto preenchimento conforme a legislação vigente e diretrizes internas.

Realiza a classificação contábil de acordo com o plano de contas e apoia na elaboração de relatórios e demonstrativos periódicos de desempenho.

Atua nos processos das áreas contábil, contas a receber (faturamento) e contas a pagar do Iberostar, participando também das rotinas fiscais e tributárias.

Executa atividades de controle interno com foco na identificação de riscos, além da elaboração de papéis de trabalho e relatórios de auditoria.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Conciliações contábeis, orientando lançamentos e efetuando ajustes, quando necessário, visando a observância da alocação das despesas.
  • Reporte e contato direito com pessoal do escritório da Bahia.
  • Acompanha fiscalizações, visitas, auditorias internas e externas, apresentando documentos e outros registros e controles, prestando esclarecimentos, recebendo e assinando notificações, tomando providências negociadas, envolvendo gestores, a fim de dirimir possíveis questões legais e judiciais.
  • Recebe fiscais da Receita Federal, da Prefeitura e peritos da justiça, identificando propósitos das visitas, verificando credenciais, a fim de providenciar o atendimento das solicitações.
  • Assessora os auditores internos e externos, fornecendo informações contábeis da empresa e documentações conforme as normas da empresa, visando à transparência da gestão e atendimento as exigências legais e fiscais.
  • Controla fluxo de pagamentos, através de planilha e relatórios gerados, indicando oportunidades de melhores ganhos financeiros, a fim de identificar distorções e oportunidades de melhoria para o desempenho econômico-financeiro da empresa.

title: Especialista de People Analytics
description:
PROPÓSITO DO CARGO

Liderar a estratégia de dados e análises voltadas a pessoas, transformando dados de RH em insights acionáveis que suportem decisões de negócio sobre força de trabalho, retenção, desempenho e planejamento de capital humano.

PRINCIPAIS ATRIBUIÇÕES E RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Desenvolver, implementar e manter modelos analíticos e dashboards que traduzam dados de RH em inteligência estratégica para a liderança e área de negócio.
  • Conduzir análises preditivas e descritivas sobre temas como rotatividade (turnover), absenteísmo, desempenho, engajamento e produtividade.
  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico da área de Gestão de Pessoas, apoiando iniciativas de transformação cultural, desenvolvimento organizacional e gestão de talentos baseadas em dados.
  • Liderar projetos de estruturação de bases de dados e governança de dados de RH, garantindo qualidade, integridade e segurança das informações.
  • Colaborar com TI, Finanças e áreas de negócio na integração de dados e no desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas end-to-end.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais, apresentações executivas e materiais de storytelling com dados para C-level e lideranças sênior.
  • Coordenar a implementação e evolução de ferramentas de BI e plataformas de analytics (ex.: Power BI, Tableau, Workday Analytics, SAP SuccessFactors).
  • Definir e monitorar KPIs e OKRs da área de pessoas, propondo ações corretivas com base em tendências identificadas.
  • Realizar benchmarks de mercado sobre práticas de People Analytics e recomendar inovações e melhorias de processo.
  • Orientar e desenvolver analistas da equipe em boas práticas de análise de dados, modelagem e visualização.

FORMAÇÃO ACADÊMICA

  • Graduação em Administração de Empresas, Engenharia, Economia, Estatística, Ciência da Computação, Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação, MBA ou especialização em People Analytics, Gestão de Pessoas, Data Science ou Business Intelligence será considerado diferencial.

CONHECIMENTOS TÉCNICOS REQUERIDOS

Análise de Dados e Estatística

  • Conhecimento sólido em métodos estatísticos aplicados a RH: regressão, clustering, análise de sobrevivência, séries temporais.
  • Domínio de linguagem Python e/ou R para análise e modelagem de dados.
  • Proficiência em SQL para extração e manipulação de dados em bancos relacionais.

Business Intelligence e Visualização

  • Experiência comprovada em ferramentas de BI: Power BI, Tableau ou similares — incluindo criação de relatórios, dashboards e modelagem de dados.
  • Habilidade na construção de storytelling com dados para públicos executivos.

Sistemas de RH (HRIS)

  • Familiaridade com sistemas de RH como SAP SuccessFactors, Workday, TOTVS RH, Oracle HCM ou similares.
  • Conhecimento em APIs e integração de dados entre sistemas de RH e plataformas analíticas.

People Analytics e RH Estratégico

  • Experiência em análise de dados de workforce: headcount, turnover, absenteísmo, time-to-hire, NPS interno, remuneração e benefícios.
  • Conhecimento de frameworks como Workforce Planning, HR Scorecard e OKRs de pessoas.
  • Entendimento do ciclo completo de gestão de talentos: atração, desenvolvimento, engajamento e retenção.

Competências Comportamentais Diferenciadoras

  • Raciocínio analítico e pensamento crítico orientado a dados.
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva para traduzir análises complexas em linguagem de negócio.
  • Visão estratégica e capacidade de influenciar decisões com base em evidências.
  • Autonomia, proatividade e capacidade de gestão de múltiplos projetos simultâneos.

EXPERIÊNCIA DESEJADA

  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, sendo ao menos 2 anos em People Analytics ou área correlata de RH.
  • Experiência em empresas de médio ou grande porte com culturas orientadas a dados.
  • Experiência em projetos de implementação ou evolução de sistemas HRIS será considerada diferencial.

Fomos reconhecidos pela Great Place to Work (GPTW) e pelo GPTW Diversidade como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar.

Visão Geral da Posição:

Advogado(a) apto(a) a prestar assessoraria em demandas jurídicas diversas, voltadas a contratos, bem como a prestar atendimento e suporte às demandas requisitadas pelos stakeholders e gestores internos.

Responsabilidades:

  • Gestão de contratos;
  • Elaboração e revisão de instrumentos contratuais;
  • Auditoria contratual;
  • Conhecimento multidisciplinar de Contratos;
  • Análise elaboração de relatórios sobre o acervo de contratos;
  • Suporte jurídico às operações da companhia;
  • Acompanhamento de demandas jurídicas diversas;
  • Emissão de relatórios semanais contemplando as demandas jurídicas suportadas;
  • Suporte aos gestores da área;
  • Resolução de questionamentos e temas vinculados à área de atuação;
  • Capacidade de entender as necessidades das rotinas da área, bem como identificar oportunidades de melhoria.

Requisitos:

  • Graduação em Direito, com registro ativo na Ordem dos Advogados do Brasil (OAB);
  • Desejável Pós-graduação em Direito dos Contratos;
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos na área;
  • Conhecimento em inglês será considerado um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento em outros idiomas será considerado um diferencial;
  • Compreensão da legislação vinculada à área;
  • Capacidade analítica relevante;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de articular conceitos complexos de forma clara e concisa;
  • Orientação para resultados, com habilidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas e prioridades.

Nossos desafios são para pessoas que:

  • Sabem que #JuntosSomosMaisFortes e que, em time, entregamos mais e melhor do que individualmente
  • Aprendem e se adaptam todos os dias, sem perder sua essência
  • Mantém a disciplina e a coragem para alcançar grandes resultados

Queremos você em nosso time. Venha fazer parte!

title: Technical Solution Engineer - Sao Paulo
description:
About CATL

CATL invites you to continue our legend of green energy!

CATL is a World Fortune 300 Company, a global leader who provides premier EV battery and energy storage battery for the world. CATL's EV battery consumption volume has ranked No.1 in the world for seven consecutive years and global energy storage battery shipment has also ranked No.1 for three consecutive years.

Job Description

ESS Technical Solution Engineer is the combination of application engineer and sales engineer. A technical solution engineer should support and service the customer by demonstrating the product function, technical benefits and value to help customer meet their company and business goals and help company to win projects. Combining technical knowledge with strong communication and interpersonal skills, work closely with clients, understanding their specific needs, and then leverage their in-depth understanding of the company's products or services to provide tailored solutions that meet those needs effectively. Additionally, technical solution engineers should gather feedback from clients and bridge the gap between internal development team and customer requirements, helping to refine products and services based on customer needs and experiences.

Responsibilities:

  1. Product Demonstration: Deep understanding of the products or services of products and company. Be able to explain complex technical concepts to clients in a clear and understandable manner and contribute to sales presentations, as well as demonstrating products benefits, value and completed applications
  2. Client Engagement: Interact directly with clients to understand their needs, challenges, and requirements as well as the competition information from the competitors. Engage in discussions to gather information, analyze the client's projects and requirements, and identify opportunities where company's solutions can add value to win the opportunities
  3. Solution Development: Once understand the client's needs, sales engineers work to develop solutions that align with the client's projects. This may involve collaborating with the technical team to design tailored solutions that address specific challenges. Provide clients with technical support as needed and relay information to our development teams for product development and update needs
  4. Proposal Creation: Create detailed proposals that outline the proposed solution and its benefits. These proposals need to address the technical aspects while also highlighting the business value for the client as well as prepare the documents according to customer requirements which may include specifications, user’s manual, disposal proposal, etc.,
  5. Technical Support: Provide ongoing technical support to clients, answering questions, addressing concerns, and helping with any technical issues that arise
  6. Technical Agreement Negotiations: Involve in negotiations with clients, addressing any technical concerns, clarifying expectations, and ensuring that both parties are aligned on the proposed solution to form final technical agreement
  7. Risk Assessment and Problem Solving: Identify the possible issues ahead and provide preventative solutions for the risks. Resolve the technical issues during manufacturing, delivering and commissioning until successfully hand over to customer. Cooperate with internal development and project management team if needed
  8. Market Research: Stay informed about market trends, competitor offerings, and customer feedback. Generate ideas for product and service improvement and innovation based on market trends and customer inputs

Requirements and skills:

  1. Based in (or open to relocation) Sao Paulo
  2. At least 2 years work experience in local ESS market
  3. Previous work experience as an AE or SE of ESS market is advantageous
  4. Previous experience in utility or ESS developer company is advantageous
  5. Knowledge of local ESS projects development requirements is advantageous
  6. Exceptional customer service and interpersonal skills
  7. Excellent market and competitor analysis abilities
  8. Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities
  9. Superb collaboration and communication
  10. Superb logical and strategic thinking abilities
  11. Proficient in English & Portuguese

description:
Job Description

Você se identifica com ambiente dinâmico, com empresas em momento de startup que proporcionam alto potencial de crescimento profissional?

Estamos em busca de Pessoas Campeãs que queiram se desafiar e estar conosco para alçar voos cada vez mais altos!

  • Liderando um time direto, fica responsável pelos Canais de Distribuição, Redes e Território (Canal Independente)

  • Ser corresponsável na definição de um GTM de vendas otimizada, eficiente e rentável para o cumprimento dos objetivos traçados; Identificando lacunas nas áreas de cobertura dentro do território e avaliando oportunidades de investimento em cobertura. (Gestão de White Space);
  • Gerir Sell In, Sell Out, Estoques e política comercial dos Canais de Redes e Distribuição;
  • Implementar, acompanhar e apoiar os planos (JBPs) dos parceiros de Distribuição e Redes;
  • Redes: Implementar, acompanhar e Liderar as estratégias dos trimestres para a ativação do portfólio de marcas em coordenando a execução das equipes de Venda incluindo política de varejo, planos de clientes por UF, DOH da UF;
  • Assegurar a execução do plano de ativação em linha com o orçamento, atuando rapidamente no caso de ações corretivas e influenciando todas as áreas envolvidas no alcance dos resultados;
  • Canal Independente (Território): Desenvolver, o canal do varejo independente através de um time de 2 gestores e mais de 20 executivos, buscando atingir a melhor distribuição numérica, faturamento, mix e evolução dos itens prioritários (lançamentos);

  • Ensino Superior Completo (Cursos de exatas: Engenharias, Economia, Física, Estatísticas, Matemática, Adm e etc.,);
  • Pós graduação (Diferencial)
  • Experiência Comercial (Indústrias de bens de consumo - indispensável);

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Cloud Infrastructure Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will:

  • Hands‑on AWS operations (EC2, VPC, IAM, EKS, RDS, S3, CloudWatch).
  • Azure operations experience (VMs, VNet, NSG, AKS, Entra ID, Firewall, LB).
  • Strong troubleshooting & incident management (cloud, on‑prem, Linux/Windows).
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep/ARM, CDK).
  • Scripting/automation (PowerShell, Python, Bash).

And much better if you stand out for:

  • Familiarity with containerization technologies beyond basics (Docker + Kubernetes in production).
  • Strong understanding of networking concepts (routing, load balancing, security).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps workflows focused on reliability, patching, backup & DR.
  • Ability to create and maintain operational runbooks and documentation.
  • Prior participation in on-call rotations and leading post‑incident reviews.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Operate and support AWS (primary) and Azure (secondary) cloud environments.
  • Handle tickets, incidents, troubleshooting, and root‑cause analysis.
  • Maintain core AWS and Azure services, including compute, networking, security, and Kubernetes.
  • Monitor performance, capacity, cost, and proactively resolve risks.
  • Execute changes through change management with minimal disruption.
  • Support hybrid cloud connectivity (VPN, Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, DNS).
  • Participate in on‑call rotation and lead post‑incident reviews.
  • Maintain documentation, runbooks, and automate tasks with scripting.
  • Contribute to CI/CD and DevOps workflows for stability, patching, backup, and DR.

Key Words:

  • AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, EKS, RDS, S3, CloudWatch)
  • Azure (VMs, VNet, NSG, AKS, Entra ID, Firewall, LB)
  • Kubernetes & Docker
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, ARM)
  • Scripting (PowerShell, Python, Bash)
  • Hybrid Cloud (VPN, Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, DNS)
  • Incident Management & Troubleshooting
  • CI/CD & DevOps

title: Billing Analyst
description:
About the Role We are hiring a Billing Analyst (Contracts & Invoicing) to support a high-volume, enterprise B2B billing operation within the telecommunications industry. This role owns the contractual and invoicing control stages of the Order-to-Cash process, acting as a quality, compliance, and accuracy gate between approved Purchase Orders and customer invoices. The position requires strong ERP execution, billing governance, and cross-functional organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute and control the Contracts & Invoicing stages of the Order-to-Cash process.
  • Validate sales orders and invoices against Purchase Orders (POs), contracts, pricing references, and billing structures.
  • Create, update, and validate Sales Orders in ERP systems.
  • Prepare and review invoice drafts, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness.
  • Manage invoice issuance, correction, and cancellation workflows with full traceability.
  • Register invoices and supporting documentation in official repositories.
  • Submit or share invoices through customer portals and approved channels.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Contracts, Projects, PMO, Warehouse, and Finance to obtain required billing inputs.
  • Track invoice status, blockers, aging, and SLAs, ensuring disciplined follow-up.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations.
  • Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes.
  • Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable).
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting).
  • Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance.
  • Professional proficiency in English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services.
  • Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers.
  • Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs.
  • Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments.

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós?

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

Nosso Cliente

Esta posição atuará em apoio ao nosso cliente, uma multinacional líder no segmento de cruzeiros marítimos.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop scalable RESTful or GraphQL APIs consumed by Android and iOS clients
  • Build and maintain microservices using Java, Node.js, Python, or Go (per team stack)
  • Define and document API contracts and data schemas in collaboration with mobile developers
  • Manage database design, query optimization, and migrations (SQL and/or NoSQL)
  • Implement authentication, authorization, and security best practices (OAuth 2.0, JWT)
  • Develop and maintain backend test suites; collaborate with SDETs on integration testing
  • Maintain JIRA user stories and technical tasks for backend workstream
  • Monitor service health, diagnose production issues, and lead root cause analysis
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines for backend services
  • Participate in all Agile ceremonies and technical planning sessions

Required Qualifications

  • Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team.
  • 7+ years of backend development experience
  • Proficiency in at least one backend language: Java, Node.js (TypeScript), Python, or Go
  • Strong experience designing and building RESTful APIs for mobile clients
  • Solid knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB)
  • Experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes or ECS)
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms: AWS, GCP, or Azure
  • Familiarity with JIRA for backlog and sprint management
  • Understanding of security practices: OAuth, JWT, input validation
  • Experience with automated testing and integration with CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong commitment to Test Driven Development (TDD) practices for backend service quality
  • Experience building backends specifically optimized for mobile (bandwidth-efficient, low-latency APIs)
  • Familiarity with push notification infrastructure (FCM, APNs)
  • Knowledge of event-driven architectures (Kafka, SQS/SNS)
  • Exposure to GraphQL API design

title: Engenheiro de processos sênior
description:
A Borborema Recursos Estratégicos é uma empresa brasileira que nasceu para transformar possibilidades em realidade. Desde 2021, atuamos na Bahia com foco em pesquisa mineral de terras raras, minerais essenciais para tecnologias modernas e para a transição energética.

Nosso objetivo é unir inovação, responsabilidade e eficiência para construir um futuro sustentável. Somos subsidiárias da Brazilian Rare Earths e trabalhamos para posicionar o Brasil como protagonista no setor.

MISSÃO DO CARGO:

Desenvolver estudos e análises complexas, relacionados às atividades no campo da engenharia de processos, respondendo por identificar e quantificar recursos minerais, desenvolvendo projetos de beneficiamento de minérios e metalurgia de terras raras e elementos estratégicos, por meio da realização de estudos técnicos e análises críticas de processos, para viabilizar a produção sustentável de minérios e compostos metálicos com abrangência em toda a operação da empresa, e garantir implementação de melhorias em processos e novas tecnologias.

RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO

Suportar as atividades de pesquisa e desenvolvimento de rotas de processo de beneficiamento mineral e metalurgia aplicáveis ao processo de produção de elementos de terras raras e minerais estratégicos em escala de bancada, piloto e industrial, visando otimização e inovação.

Acompanhar a realização de testes metalúrgicos de beneficiamento mineral ou metalurgia em laboratórios internos, externos e Centros de Pesquisa, garantindo a qualidade dos processos e atendendo às demandas de P&D da empresa.

Revisar documentação de projetos de beneficiamento mineral e metalurgia nas diversas fases (Scoping Study até Feasibility Study), apoiando na elaboração e revisão de fluxogramas de processo e engenharia, com o objetivo de assegurar a precisão técnica dos estudos.

Atuar de forma consultiva juntamente ao corpo técnico, direcionando na elaboração e execução de programas de testes metalúrgicos e na avaliação e consolidação de informações de processos, contribuindo para a eficiência operacional.

Elaborar e revisar relatórios e apresentações para suportar as decisões da Gerência de Processos e P&D, comunicando os resultados de forma clara e objetiva para a tomada de decisões estratégicas.

Apoiar a equipe de Engenharia, Engenharia de Minas e PMO nos estudos da disciplina de Processos para planta de beneficiamento mineral e hidrometalurgia, fornecendo suporte técnico e contribuindo para a resolução de problemas.

Cumprir e fazer cumprir as normas e metas de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente, promovendo uma cultura organizacional de responsabilidade e prevenção.

Participar ativamente na formação e desenvolvimento da equipe técnica, disseminando conhecimentos e melhorando as competências do time em processos de beneficiamento mineral.

REQUISITOS DO CARGO

Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Engenharia de Minas, Engenharia Química, Engenharia Metalúrgica e outras afins.

Idioma: Inglês Intermediário/Avançado

Disponibilidade para residir em Salvador/BA ou Lauro de Freitas/BA.

Disponibilidade para atuar eventualmente em regime de turno.

Competências Técnicas: Sólidos conhecimentos em processos metalúrgicos, beneficiamento mineral, elaboração de estudos de viabilidade, gerenciamento de projetos e domínio de softwares de modelagem de processos.

COMPETÊNCIAS COMPORTAMENTAIS

Proatividade, orientação para resultados, habilidades de comunicação, trabalho em equipe, capacidade de análise crítica, resolução de problemas complexos, flexibilidade e espírito inovador.

title: AI Project Manager
description:
We are seeking a senior Project Manager to join our team.

The ideal candidate must have a strong background in project management, specifically in the AI domain.

This role involves overseeing ongoing AI projects , managing client relationships , coordinating with internal teams , and ensuring the successful delivery of projects .

We are looking for individuals who are not only skilled in project management but also enthusiastic about AI and eager to drive new solutions.

While technical expertise is valuable, the primary focus is on project management , product ownership and client satisfaction . This role sits in the Digital Transformation Center and will be close to delivery and research teams.

  • Work model: remote from Brazil;
  • Contract type: contractor / “PJ”;
  • Availability to work according to North American’s Eastern Standard Time (EST).

Job Mission :

  • To manage AI projects, ensuring successful delivery.
  • To encourage a culture of excellence within the team.
  • To advance AI initiatives through cross-functional collaboration.
  • To engage across functions (SMEs, technical teams, leaderships) to guarantee delivery quality.

Key Responsibilities :

  • Project Management: Lead end-to-end project management for AI initiatives, from initiation to successful delivery. Develop project plans, allocate resources, track progress, and ensure timely completion of milestones and deliverables;
  • Client Engagement: Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, maintaining strong relationships and ensuring clear communication. Understand client needs, manage expectations, and address concerns promptly to achieve customer satisfaction;
  • Risk Management: Identify potential project risks and develop mitigation strategies. Proactively address issues that may impact project timelines, scope, or quality, ensuring smooth project execution;
  • Reporting and Documentation: Maintain accurate project documentation, including project plans, progress reports, and stakeholder communications. Ensure that project status and updates are communicated effectively to both internal teams and clients;
  • Team Leadership: Provide leadership and direction to project teams, fostering a collaborative and results-driven environment. Mentor team members, promote knowledge sharing, and support professional growth;
  • Global Approach: Interact with other regions, partners and ventures following a global approach to ensure consistency and alignment in AI project management across the organization.

Required Experience :

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Project Management, or a related field;
  • Experience in managing projects AI projects from conception to delivery;
  • Familiarity with AI technologies and their applications;
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders;
  • Proficiency in project management methodologies and tools;
  • Problem-solving mindset with the ability to navigate challenges and adapt to changing project requirements;
  • Critical thinking and problem solving to assess client situation and provide actionable outcome-based business/technical advice;
  • PMP, PMI-ACP, or other relevant project management certifications (preferred);
  • Proficiency in English is mandatory;
  • Proficiency in Portuguese is desirable.

Required Technical Knowledge :

  • Familiarity with AI concepts, terminology, and industry trends;
  • Understanding of project management methodologies specific to AI projects;
  • Ability to evaluate technical feasibility and make informed project decisions based on technical considerations;
  • Proficiency in using project management software and tools for AI project tracking and management;
  • Knowledge and experience on conducting projects for IT and Service Desk solutions.
  • A background in IT environments, including an understanding of how various IT components and systems operate, is highly beneficial. This knowledge helps in navigating technical aspects, ensuring seamless integration of AI solutions within existing IT infrastructures;
  • Product ownership and ability to work in an agile environment and create user stories;
  • Excellent communication skills;
  • Strong project management skills.

What's next:

title: AI Agent Development & Delivery Manager-Brazil
description:
AI Agent Builder Job Core Responsibilities

AI Agent Builder Core Qualifications

  • Language: Fluent in English (Spoken & Written). You can confidently lead technical meetings and write high-quality, professional prompts/documentation.

  • Basic Python/JS skills (must know how to parse JSON and handle API/Webhook data).
  • Conceptual understanding of LLMs and a strong intuition for Prompt Engineering .
  • Fast Learner: Ability to quickly master new Agent Builder/Workflow tools (e.g., Coze, n8n) and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

title: FinCrime Escalations Officer
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Financial Crime Operations is at the forefront of Revolut’s efforts to keep customers and their money safe. Team members work directly with customers to resolve issues and flag potential concerns. Using cutting-edge technology and sharp attention to detail, they help prevent financial crime and keep trust at the core of Revolut.

We’re looking for an Escalations Officer to ensure effective and compliant suspicious activity reporting in Brazil. You'll be performing assessments and making decisions on cases, which are escalated from the first line of defence.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What you’ll be doing

  • Acting as the escalation point for suspicious activity cases
  • Ensuring accurate and timely SARs are submitted according to local requirements
  • Responding to regulatory inquiries and other requests from local authorities related to SARs
  • Managing queries requiring a second line of defence review
  • Working with the MLRO and escalating significant cases
  • Monitoring and detecting rare or new patterns, and reporting emerging trends in suspicious activity
  • Resolving escalated cases, following expected resolution times
  • Participating in projects with management as required
  • Collaborating on training initiatives and implementation of new processes

What you'll need

  • Experience as a compliance/FinCrime officer in a major financial institution
  • Experience in FinCrime operations acting as the escalation point
  • Deep knowledge of AML and sanctions regulations
  • Experience using internal and external systems and databases to conduct investigations
  • The ability to review policies and procedures and advise if changes are required
  • Problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to analyse complex information to identify the key issue/action and drive resolutions
  • The ability to present a summary and conclusion to management promptly, including clear proposals to implement appropriate steps to mitigate risk and/or monitor it
  • An understanding of payment systems and markets with a focus on technology and mobile applications
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

title: Subject Matter Expert - Chartered & Certified Accountants (Remote)
description:

Hourly Rate: $60.00

Minimum Hours: No minimum

Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability

About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.

The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a "bench" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.

What you’ll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional "human-in-the-loop" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.

What you’ll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.

Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour , you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.

Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again; simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.

Links to more information on Prolific

Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

title: Consultor Comercial — Compra de Ouro
description:

Sobre a Ouro Pago Somos a Ouro Pago, a maior referência em compra de ouro de Natal. Há mais de 10 anos no mercado, construímos uma operação que combina tecnologia de avaliação, exportação direta e o melhor preço da praça. É por isso que clientes de toda a cidade chegam até a gente.
